scripts.verify:legacy-floor: npm run build && npm run verify:oracle && npm run verify:help && npm run verify:bundle && npm run test
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:legacy-floor && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:arch: npx depcruise packages/domain/src packages/contracts/src packages/db/src packages/testkit/src apps/api/src apps/workspace/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.verify:archive-hygiene: node tools/run_python_tool.js -m unittest tests/tooling/test_archive_hygiene.py && node tools/run_python_tool.js tools/verify_archive_hygiene.py
scripts.verify:phase1: npm run verify:phase0 && npm run verify:phase1:contracts && npm run typecheck:v4 && npm run verify:arch && npm run test:unit && npm run test:db:migrations && npm run test:db --workspace @symphony/db && npm run test:api && npm run test:workspace && npm run test:bdd:phase1 && npm run verify:trace && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:login:api && npm run verify:legacy-floor && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:phase0: npm run test:phase0-contract && npm run test:toolchain && npm run verify:toolchain && npm run verify:archive-hygiene && npm run typecheck:v4 && npm run verify:arch && npm run test:unit && npm run test:db:migrations && npm run test:bdd && npm run verify:trace && npm run test:a11y && npm run verify:legacy-floor
scripts.verify:v4: npm run verify:arch && npm run test:unit && npm run test:bdd && npm run verify:trace && npm run verify:all
scripts.typecheck:v4: npx tsc --build --force packages/domain packages/contracts packages/db packages/testkit && npm run typecheck --workspace @symphony/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @symphony/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @symphony/db && npm run typecheck --workspace @symphony/testkit && npm run typecheck --workspace @symphony/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @symphony/workspace
scripts.test:bdd: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx npx cucumber-js --config cucumber.cjs --profile default
scripts.build:workspace: cd apps/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build
